strict_invariants: Finite positive raw weights; every node strictly inside the true disk AND pixel; empty/tangent returns no nodes/weights. No tolerance for membership or positivity, clipping or renormalization.

configurations.name: vertical_edge_partial
configurations.area: segment x>=-1/4; full disk y span covered

configurations.name: tangent_empty
configurations.area: zero; touches disk at single right pole

reservation_derivation: Sum coefficients28 times(16^2+32^2)=35840. Covered x/y partitions are2x2 for vertical/mirror/translated/full-disk/interior,4x2 for axis exchange,zero for empty/tangent. Reserve before every utility call.
stop: First invariant/cap/deadline failure; no utility edit, alternate order, repair or retry. Fixed16 then32 per case. First configuration is checkpoint.
zero: Optical imports/bodies, actual height adapters, tracers, source/target/radiance pixels, rays, filters, composites, images and fits
